traits.name: fierce
traits.reason: No conflict or damage appears; no sharp lines and no mending.

traits.name: loyal
traits.reason: She reaches out to peers and offers trade, but gives no directions, bridges, or joy at arrivals.

traits.name: jealous
traits.reason: No mention of anyone who left and no sign of building harder.

traits.name: vain
traits.reason: Trail updates hint at pride in her walking, but there is no pleased talk of bridges or trail quality.

traits.name: chime like
traits.reason: Short lines like 'Chime. walked 4 legs.' fit, but the greetings run long, name peers, and lack headings, counts, or exclamations.
